scope.basis: Initial documented selection of road pieces and track-mounted accessories.
scope.availability: Historical and current products are mixed; catalogue inclusion does not imply current availability.

unresolved: Lengths and identities use Carrera documents; width, spacing and R1/R2 road-edge diameters use independent published measurements. Exact mould tolerances are not established.
Crossovers, narrow sections, banking, loops, junctions and digital switches are reference-only; their actual paths and elevation are not replaced by straight/flat geometry.
R3 identity/45-degree angle is published, but its road-edge diameter remains unverified in this pack; no buildable model is supplied.
